item.title: Buying a home in Denmark as an international: What you really need to know
item.description: Buying a home in Denmark can feel like a final exam for many internationals. It’s tricky to navigate, but someone who has done it is now sharing tips for others on how to succeed.

item.title: Spotify increases revenue with more paying subscribers
item.description: Spotify increased its number of paying subscribers in 2025, which also raised the company’s revenue. In the fourth quarter, the music streaming service reported revenue of 4.5 billion euros, about 34 billion Danish kroner. Revenue grew seven percent compared with the same quarter in 2024.
